svg.title: Crew (tp::crew): what a team knows of the lane, and where it starts the sled

g.text: Crew (tp::crew): what a team knows of the lane, and where it starts the sled
+report(const track::Model&, const Knowledge&, until_m, seed) : Report
uncertainty: 1 / (1 + pulls_seen / 4), halved in the pull-off;
each spot is missed with chance kMissedShare x uncertainty, else reported
off by up to the errors x uncertainty, in place, strength and size
(five draws per spot, seen or not);
best_line_m: every line 0.1 m apart within max_offset_m, the middle first:
a weak spot under either rear side costs its strength x length (the open
differential), a hard spot under the pan half that per share it covers;
the cheapest, nearest the middle; the field's rivals and the player's
